description: Discriminator: a leader in ACCEPTED state at ballot 3 receives an AcceptReply with ballot 5 from a peer that has promised a higher ballot. Prefix: the harness builds the leader's round with the reviewed constructors and calls the real handleAcceptReply. Controls: the events print the round's ballot and status, then the reply ballot together with the nack count, accept count, whether any message was emitted and the status after the call.

harness.description: In-package Go test that prepares an ACCEPTED leader round and delivers one higher-ballot AcceptReply to the real handler, reporting the counters and any emitted message.
semantic_changes: harness-only scaffolding: the Replica is constructed in-package with buffer peer writers, the round is built with the package's own instance and bookkeeping constructors, and the reply is delivered directly to the handler
the reply is the value handleAccept produces for a peer with a higher stored bal; no protocol code is modified

legality.derivation: Both sides are the implementation's own: the round is the state a leader reaches after the accept branch, and the reply is what handleAccept sends when its bal exceeds the accept ballot.
legality.applicability: N=3, Thrifty, IsLeader true, one reply.
unresolved: the timeout-driven recovery path is not exercised

grounding.derivation: The event reports the rejection counters and whether the leader reacted, which is the branch's own duty.
grounding.applicability: The leader was in the accept phase and the reply's ballot exceeded the round's.

observable_properties.description: A reply whose ballot exceeds the accept round's ballot must be recorded as one nack.

uncertainties: the check does not exercise the timeout-driven recovery that can also advance the instance
the majority-nack consequence is not reached because the check delivers a single reply
